modules.module_title: Select and prepare the site for the cultivation of pulses

pcs.pc_description: check the site has conducive climatic conditions for the cultivation of pulses and is free from limiting factors such as flooding, drought, extreme heat and cold
coordinate with an authorised lab to determine if the soil is suitable for the cultivation of pulses
ensure the site is accessible and has availability of quality water, labour and other inputs
identify the risks associated with the cultivation of pulses at the site and take appropriate preventive measures

modules.module_title: Procure and prepare the pulse seeds for sowing

pcs.pc_description: select the appropriate variety of pulses to be cultivated based on the climate, soil condition, time of planting, cultivation duration, marketability, etc.
procure high quality certified pulse seeds with resistance to local pests and diseases from a government-approved source in the required quantity
treat the pulse seeds using the recommended biofertilizer,insecticide, pesticide or fungicide in the prescribed dose
remove and dispose the damaged/ diseased seeds
store the treated seeds at the recommended temperature and humidity, ensuring hygienic conditions in the storage area
remove all the weeds and waste materials from the field
identify the soil type and carry out ploughing in the field to achieve the required tilt
level the field appropriately to ensure uniformly graded field
create ridges and furrows in the field to avoid waterlogging
apply the recommended organic manure in the field in an appropriate quantity
check the soil’s pH level using the pH meter and apply lime, gypsum or other relevant treatment in an appropriate quantity to adjust the pH
adopt zero tillage or minimum tillage practices where feasible to conserve soil moisture
follow the recommended sowing period for the chosen pulse crop based on climatic condition
select an appropriate method for sowing pulse seeds such as broadcasting or mechanised sowing
sow the pulse seeds at the appropriate seed rate using the relevant tools and implements
maintain the recommended planting depth and density to achieve the healthy growth of plants
carry out intercropping with a suitable crop to achieve a higher yield
integrate pulses into crop rotations to enhance soil fertility and reduce pest build-up
optimise the usage of water and other resources in various tasks and processes
plug water leakages to prevent its wastage
segregate waste into appropriate categories
recycle the recyclable waste appropriately and dispose the non-recyclable waste in an environment-friendly manner

modules.module_title: Identify pests and disease in pulses

pcs.pc_description: follow the recommended Integrated Pest Management (IPM) methods such as light and pheromone traps to identify the presence and population of pests, insects and vectors such as pod borers, hairy caterpillar, aphids, stem fly, whitefly, thrips, beetles, nematodes, etc.
conduct regular field visits to identify major pulse diseases such as leaf spot, leaf blight, anthracnose, Powdery mildew, root rot, rust, yellow mosaic, etc.
identify the symptoms of pests and disease and determine the mode of pest and disease transfer
identify the part of the crop affected by pests and disease
determine the stage of pest and disease incidence along with the extent of damage and economic threshold levels (ETL) of the pests
check and document the pest
co-ordinate with the agricultural extension service agents and diagnostic clinics to determine the causal organism for the disease and its treatment

modules.module_title: Identify and apply the necessary treatment

pcs.pc_description: identify natural enemies of the pulses pests such as ladybird, ground beetles, hoverfly, parasitoids and adopt them for pest control according to the advice of agricultural extension service workers, Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK), diagnostic clinics, etc.

apply the recommended treatment as per the prescription to remove pests and disease
follow the recommended safety practices while applying any treatment, such as using the relevant PPE
maintain the record of the use of any pesticides, insecticides and any other treatment
